items.title: Oil Prices Spike After Iran Launches Surprise Attack on U.S. Forces
items.summary: Oil prices settled higher Wednesday after President Donald Trump said the U.S. was going to to be striking Iran “very hard” following reports of a drone attack that set fire to a U.S.-owned liquified natural gas carrier at Egypt’s Damietta port.  Prices were already rising earlier in the day in response to the U.S. military’s interception of Iranian ballistic missiles aimed at American forces in Jordan.  Shortly after that attack, the U.S. and Saudi Arabia launched strikes in Iraq against Iran-backed groups that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps previously directed to attack American troops and Saudi energy infrastructure.
